Title: Sancti patris nostri Ephraem Syri Opera omnia quae exstant Graece, Syriace, Latine, in sex tomos distributa ... Syriace et Latine, tomus secundus
Creator: Ephrem the Syrian; the Syriac text edited, pointed and translated into Latin by Petrus Benedictus, S.J., in the Roman edition directed by Joseph Simonius Assemani (title page)
Publisher: Romae: ex Typographia Pontificia Vaticana, apud Jo. Mariam Henricum Salvioni (title page)
Publication Date: 1740 (title page, OCR line 3595: 'M, DCC XL.')
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1740); the archive.org record carries no rights field, so the imprint date is the basis. The scan carries no notice against reproduction.
Language: syr-lat
Source: archive.org item assemani-et-alii-1732-1746-ephraem-syri-opera-omnia-syr-2 (an uploader's scan with no library named), full text from the item's own djvu.txt at https://archive.org/download/assemani-et-alii-1732-1746-ephraem-syri-opera-omnia-syr-2/Assemani et alii 1732-1746 - Ephraem Syri opera omnia Syr 2_djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-26 by the Open-Gaps 417 source-research session (era 1: Bardaisan, the Modalists, Danubian Latin Christianity); the byte count of the downloaded file (2,398,035) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers. OCR quality: the Syriac is garbage and cannot be quoted; the Latin is readable but the long s is read as f throughout ('fermones', 'fuperat') and other letters are misread, a pattern the quote gate does not normalize. SECOND WITNESS ONLY: Benedictus's Latin is an eighteenth-century translation, and with this OCR it is used to find and cross-check passages, never quoted. Rights basis restated: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1740).
Content note: The 56 Sermones (madrashe) adversus haereses, Syriac with Latin, from OCR line 87512 ('Sermo primus') to about 111800: Ephrem's hymns against Bardaisan, Marcion and Mani, with the passages on Bardaisan and the Bardaisanites ('Bardefanis', 'Bardefaniftarum' in this OCR). Other works of the volume precede them.
